function GameHelper:GetClosestDestructibleCraft(destroyer:Model,radius:number)
    if not radius then radius = 100 end

    local humanoidRootPart:Part = destroyer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return end
	local closest = nil
	local shortestDist = radius

    local op = OverlapParams.new()
    op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DestructibleCraft))
    op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local checkedCraft = {}
    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(humanoidRootPart.Position,radius,op)
    for _,hit:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
        local craft:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.DestructibleCraft)
        if checkedCraft[craft] then continue end
        checkedCraft[craft] = true

		local dist = (craft:GetPivot().Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
        if dist <= shortestDist then
            closest = craft
            shortestDist = dist
        end
    end

	return closest
end

function GameHelper:TreeTakeDamge(player:Player,tree:Model,damage:number)
    local hp = tree:GetAttribute("hp")
    if not hp or hp <= 0 then return false end
    hp = hp - damage
    tree:SetAttribute("hp", hp)

    if hp <= 0 then
        -- math.randomseed(tick())

        local woodCount = 3
        local seekCount = 0
        if tree:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree) then
            woodCount = 16
            seekCount = 4
        else
            local r = math.random(1,4)
            local isSpawn = r > 1
            -- print("是否生成树",r)
            if isSpawn then
                seekCount = 1
            end
        end

        if player then
            if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WoodV2) then
                -- math.randomseed(tick())
                local isTrigger = math.random(1,5) == 1
                if isTrigger then
                    woodCount += math.random(1,2)
                end
            elseif player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WoodV1) then
                -- math.randomseed(tick())
                local isTrigger = math.random(1,5) == 1
                if isTrigger then
                    woodCount += 1
                end
            end

            if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WoodSeedV1) then
                if seekCount > 0 then
                    -- math.randomseed(tick())
                    local isTrigger = math.random(1,4) == 1
                    if isTrigger then
                        seekCount *= 2
                    end
                end
            end
            
            GameHelper.FelledTreeS2C:FireClient(player,tree)
            GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.cutTree)
        end

        local cframe = tree:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0,5,0)
        for i=1,woodCount do
            local wook = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateWood()
            wook:PivotTo(cframe * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(0,359)),math.rad(math.random(0,359)),math.rad(math.random(0,359))))
        end

        if not tree:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.SeedlessTree) then
            -- 非无籽树才会生成树苗
            for i=1,seekCount do
                local seek = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateTreeSeek()
                seek:PivotTo(cframe * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(0,359)),math.rad(math.random(0,359)),math.rad(math.random(0,359))))
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end

function GameHelper:MarkDailyQuestStatsOnce(player:Player,questId:number,add:number?)
    if not GameHelper.DailyQuestMarks then
        GameHelper.DailyQuestMarks = {}
    end
    if GameHelper.DailyQuestMarks[questId] then return end
    GameHelper.DailyQuestMarks[questId] = true
    DataHelper:MarkDailyQuestStats(player,questId,add)
end

function GameHelper:MarkDailyQuestStatsByProcessor(player:Player,processor:string,add:number?)
    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
    if not playerVo or not playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords then
        return
    end

    print("检测",player.DisplayName,"日常任务完成情况，处理器",processor)
    for classes,dailyQuestVo in pairs(playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords) do
        local lo:DailyQuestsSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(DailyQuestsSetting,dailyQuestVo.questId)
        if not lo then
            warn("无效日常任务记录", player.DisplayName, "questId", dailyQuestVo.questId)
            continue
        end
        if lo.processor ~= processor then continue end

        if processor == CommonEnum.DailyQuests.completedWanteds then
            -- 完成悬赏令
        else
            -- 通用累计
            DataHelper:MarkDailyQuestStats(player,dailyQuestVo.questId,add)
        end
    end
end

function GameHelper:Store(player:Player,item:Model)
    local storedTag = string.format("Stored_%d",player.UserId)
    if not item:HasTag(storedTag) then
        if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(item) then
            -- 统计角色技能要求
            local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item)
            -- 指定物品收集统计
            GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,CommonEnum.Stats.GetStoreResItemKey(resLo.id),1)
            -- 指定物品类型收集统计
            GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,CommonEnum.Stats.GetStoreResItemTypeKey(resLo.ItemType),1)
        end
        item:AddTag(storedTag)
    end

    BagHelper:Store(player,item)
end

    end

    if not table.find(_eatMarks[player.UserId],id) then
        table.insert(_eatMarks[player.UserId],id)

    end
end

    if not _eatMarks[player.UserId] then

end

function GameHelper:CancelPlayerSessionCleanup(userId:number)
    local version = (_sessionCleanupVersions[userId] or 0) + 1
    _sessionCleanupVersions[userId] = version
end

function GameHelper:ClearPlayerSessionCache(userId:number)
    if game.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId) then return end

    GameHelper.playerDataCaches[userId] = nil
    _eatMarks[userId] = nil
    _sessionCleanupVersions[userId] = nil
end

function GameHelper:SchedulePlayerSessionCleanup(userId:number)
    local version = (_sessionCleanupVersions[userId] or 0) + 1
    _sessionCleanupVersions[userId] = version

    task.delay(GameHelper.ReconnectionGraceSeconds,function()
        if _sessionCleanupVersions[userId] ~= version then return end
        GameHelper:ClearPlayerSessionCache(userId)
    end)
end

function GameHelper:IsLampLight(player:Player)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    local lamp = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
    if lamp and lamp:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Lamp) then
        local v_isLight:BoolValue = lamp:FindFirstChild("isLight")
        return v_isLight.Value
    end
end

function GameHelper:GetLampLightRange(player:Player)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    local lamp = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
    if lamp and lamp:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Lamp) then
        local SpotLight = lamp:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpotLight",true)
        return SpotLight.Range
    end
    return 0
end

function GameHelper:PlayAddGem(worldPos:Vector3)
    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("拾取Gem")
    local gem:CanvasGroup = UIHelper:GetRootGUI("UIResBar","gem")
    local img_icon:ImageLabel = gem:FindFirstChild("img_icon")

    local endSize = img_icon.AbsoluteSize * 1.1
    local endPos = img_icon.AbsolutePosition + GuiService:GetGuiInset() + img_icon.AnchorPoint * img_icon.AbsoluteSize
    if gem.GroupTransparency == 1 then
        TweenService:Create(gem,TweenInfo.new(1),{
            GroupTransparency = 0
        }):Play()
    end

    -- math.randomseed(tick())
    task.spawn(function()
        local Tip_AddGem:Frame = UIHelper:GetRootGUI("UIGameTip","Tip_AddGem")
        local img_gem_start:ImageLabel = Tip_AddGem:FindFirstChild("img_gem_start")
        local img_gem_end:ImageLabel = Tip_AddGem:FindFirstChild("img_gem_end")

        local img_gem = img_gem_start:Clone()
        img_gem.Visible = true
        img_gem.Parent = Tip_AddGem
        Debris:AddItem(img_gem,5)

        if worldPos then
            local startPos = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
            img_gem.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(startPos.X,startPos.Y)
        end

        -- 增加随机偏移
        local r = 50
        local offset = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-r,r),math.random(-r,r))
        -- img_gem.Position += offset

        -- 先飞去屏幕中间
        TweenService:Create(img_gem,TweenInfo.new(1),{
            Position = img_gem_end.Position + offset,
            Size = img_gem_end.Size
        }):Play()
        task.wait(1)
        -- 再飞去资源图标处
        TweenService:Create(img_gem,TweenInfo.new(1),{
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(endPos.X,endPos.Y),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(endSize.X,endSize.Y),
        }):Play()
        task.wait(1)
        -- 刷新背包入包
        DataHelper.onItemChanged:Fire(nil,CommonEnum.ItemId.Gem)
        -- 淡出
        TweenService:Create(img_gem,TweenInfo.new(1),{
            ImageTransparency = 1
        }):Play()
        -- 销毁
        Debris:AddItem(img_gem,5)
        -- 延时隐藏
        TweenService:Create(gem,TweenInfo.new(1,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,5),{
            GroupTransparency = 1
        }):Play()
    end)
end

end

    local cache:PlayerGameData = {
        teleportVo = teleportVo,
        alive = true,
        rideLv = 0,
        bullets = {}
    }
    GameHelper.playerDataCaches[player.UserId] = cache
    return cache
end

function GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player:Player)
    local playerGameData = GameHelper:GetPlayerGameData(player)
    playerGameData.chestplateId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.chestplateId)
    playerGameData.faceMaskId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.faceMaskId)
    playerGameData.shoeId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.shoeId)
    playerGameData.scarfId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.scarfId)
    playerGameData.reviveTimes = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.ReviveTimes)
    for _,bulletTag in ipairs(GameEnum.BulletTags) do
        local num = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,bulletTag) or 0
        playerGameData.bullets[bulletTag] = num
    end
end

function GameHelper:GetPlayerGameData(player:Player)
    local playerDataCache = GameHelper.playerDataCaches[player.UserId]
    return playerDataCache
end

end

end

    return playerGameData.rideLv
end

function GameHelper:TryPinkup(player:Player,item:Model)
    if not item or not item:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end

    if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(item) then
        local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item)
        if not resLo or not resLo.IsTool then return end

        local owned:Player = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(item,DragItemValue.owner)
        if owned and owned ~= player then
            -- 属于其他玩家，无法拾取
            UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,string.format("This item belongs to %s.",owned.DisplayName),UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            return
        end

        if resLo.lv then
            local curTool = ToolHelper:GetToolByType(player,resLo.ItemType)
            if curTool then
                -- 判断等级
                local curToolLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(curTool)
                if curToolLo.lv and resLo.lv <= curToolLo.lv then
                    UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You already have better tools.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
                    return
                end
            end
        end

        if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) or item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bell) or resLo.noStack then
            -- 不能重复捡起相同的工具，检查下有没有这个工具
            local tools = ToolHelper:GetToolsById(player,resLo.id)
            if #tools > 0 then
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You already have better tools.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
                return
            end
        end

        -- 捡起工具
        ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,item)
		AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player,"储存/装备")
        return true
    elseif CraftItemHelper:IsCraftTool(item) then
        -- 捡起工具
        ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,item)
		AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player,"储存/装备")
        return true
    end
end

function GameHelper:TryPlayerMeleeAttack(character:Model,atkDistance:number?)
    if not character then return end
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return end

    local isHit = false
    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlapParams.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
    local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(cframe.Position, atkDistance or GameHelper.SwordAtkDistance, overlapParams)
    local checkedModels:{Model} = {}
    for _,part:BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
        if not model then continue end
        if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(model) then continue end

        if table.find(checkedModels, model) then continue end
        table.insert(checkedModels, model)

        if GameHelper:IsNPC(model) then
            if character == game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then
                -- 如果是玩家自己，才发攻击命中给服务端
                GameHelper.CharacterHitTargetC2S:FireServer(model)
                isHit = true
            end
        end
    end
    return isHit
end

function GameHelper:FindOnePlayerAttackTarget(character:Model,distance:number)
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return end

    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlapParams.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
    local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(cframe.Position, distance, overlapParams)
    local checkedModels:{Model} = {}
    local closeTarget:Model = nil
    local closeDistance:number
    for _,part:BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
        if not model then continue end
        if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(model) then continue end

        if table.find(checkedModels, model) then continue end
        table.insert(checkedModels, model)

        if GameHelper:IsNPC(model) then
            local dis = (model:GetPivot().Position - cframe.Position).Magnitude
            if not closeTarget or dis < closeDistance then
                closeTarget = model
                closeDistance = dis
            end
        end
    end

    return closeTarget
end

function GameHelper:PlayDuang(model:Model)
	task.spawn(function()
		local originScale = model:GetScale()
		local t = 0
		local tt = 0.2
		while t < tt do
			local dt = task.wait()
			t += dt
			local alpha = math.clamp(t/tt,0,1)
			--local duang = math.cos(alpha * math.pi)
			--local base = 1 -math.abs(duang)
			model:ScaleTo(0.5 * originScale + alpha * 0.8 * originScale)
		end
		
		t = 0
		tt = 0.1
		while t < tt do
			local dt = task.wait()
			t += dt
			local alpha = 1 - math.clamp(t/tt,0,1)
			--local duang = math.cos(alpha * math.pi)
			--local base = 1 -math.abs(duang)
			model:ScaleTo(originScale + 0.3 * originScale * alpha)
		end
		--Enum.EasingDirection.
		model:ScaleTo(originScale)
	end)
end

function GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
    -- 获取鼠标屏幕位置
    -- local mouseLocation = Vector2.new(mouse.X,mouse.Y)
    local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

    -- 从摄像机发射射线
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouseLocation.X, mouseLocation.Y)

    -- 射线检测
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    -- raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character} -- 排除玩家角色
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character)
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local raycastResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)

    if raycastResult then
        return raycastResult.Position -- 返回碰撞点
    end

    -- 如果没有碰撞，返回射线方向上的一个点
    return ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 1000
end

function GameHelper:FastTravel(player:Player,pos:Vector3,dismount:boolean?)
	local character:Model = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if humanoid.Sit then
        local horse:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(humanoid.SeatPart,GameEnum.Tag.Horse)
        if horse then
            if dismount then
                -- 下马
                for i=1,10 do
                    if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding) then
                        character.Humanoid.Sit = false
                        task.wait(0.1)
                    else
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
                -- 直接用坐骑传送
                horse:PivotTo(horse:GetPivot().Rotation+pos)
                task.defer(function()
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    local horseHumanoid:Humanoid = horse:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
                    horseHumanoid.Jump = true
                end)
                return
            end

        end
    end

    character:PivotTo(character:GetPivot().Rotation+pos)
end

function GameHelper:CalculateCDDiminishing(baseCooldown, cooldownReduction)
    -- 递减计算公式：实际冷却缩减 = 1 - (1 / (1 + 冷却缩减))
    local effectiveCDR = 1 - (1 / (1 + cooldownReduction))
    -- effectiveCDR = math.min(effectiveCDR, MAX_COOLDOWN_REDUCTION or 0.4)
    if effectiveCDR < 0 then
        baseCooldown = 0
    end

    return baseCooldown * (1 - effectiveCDR)
end

local _waterGunSkinEffectTag = "WaterGunSkinEffect"
local _waterGunTrailColor = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(170,244,255),Color3.fromRGB(44,125,255))
local _waterGunMuzzleEmitCount = 6
local _waterGunHitEmitCount = 10

local function emitParticleBurst(root:Instance,emitCount:number):boolean
    if not root then return false end

    local hasEmitter = false
    for _,descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            hasEmitter = true
            descendant:Emit(emitCount)
        end
    end

    return hasEmitter
end

local function playDefaultGunMuzzle(gun:Tool,firePoint:Attachment?)
    local fireAtt:Attachment = EffectHelper:CreateWorkspaceEffect("枪口火")
    fireAtt.CFrame = CFrame.new()
    fireAtt.Parent = firePoint or gun:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    EffectHelper:AddItem(fireAtt,0.1)

    local fire:ParticleEmitter = fireAtt:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ParticleEmitter")
    if fire then
        fire:Emit(5)
    end
end

local function playBulletHitEffect(effectName:string,endPos:Vector3,lifeTime:number,emitCount:number?)
    local effect = EffectHelper:CreateWorkspaceEffect(effectName)
    if not effect then return end

    local anchorAtt = effect:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Attachment",true)
    if anchorAtt then
        effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(endPos) * anchorAtt.CFrame:Inverse())
    elseif effect:IsA("BasePart") then
        effect.Position = endPos
    else
        effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(endPos))
    end

    effect.Parent = workspace
    if emitCount then
        if not emitParticleBurst(effect,emitCount) then
            CommonFunc:SetParticleEmittersEnabled(effect,true)
        end
    else
        CommonFunc:SetParticleEmittersEnabled(effect,true)
    end
    EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,lifeTime)
end

function GameHelper:PlayRegularBulletStyle(gun:Tool,endPos:Vector3,FirePoint:Attachment?,hitCharacter:boolean?)
    if not FirePoint then
        FirePoint = gun:FindFirstChild("FirePoint",true)
    end
    local PointLight:PointLight = gun:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("PointLight",true)
    local cframe:CFrame
    if FirePoint then
        cframe = FirePoint.WorldCFrame
    else
        cframe = gun:GetPivot()
    end

    local isWaterGunSkin = gun:HasTag(_waterGunSkinEffectTag)
    local bullet:Part = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("Bullet"):Clone()
    bullet.Anchored = true
    bullet.Parent = workspace
    bullet.CFrame = cframe

    if isWaterGunSkin then
        local trail:Trail = bullet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Trail",true)
        if trail then
            trail.Color = _waterGunTrailColor
        end

        local hasWaterMuzzle = FirePoint and emitParticleBurst(FirePoint,_waterGunMuzzleEmitCount)
        if not hasWaterMuzzle then
            playDefaultGunMuzzle(gun,FirePoint)
        end
    else
        playDefaultGunMuzzle(gun,FirePoint)
    end

    local distance = (cframe.Position - endPos).Magnitude
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(distance / 500,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,0.1)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(bullet,tweenInfo,{
        CFrame = cframe.Rotation + endPos
    })
    tween:Play()
    EffectHelper:AddItem(bullet,tweenInfo.Time,true)

    if not hitCharacter then
        if isWaterGunSkin then
            playBulletHitEffect("BulletWaterHit",endPos,0.8,_waterGunHitEmitCount)
        else
            playBulletHitEffect("BulletHit",endPos,0.15,nil)
        end
    end

    local sourcePlayer = gun.Parent and gun.Parent:IsA("Model") and game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(gun.Parent)
    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("GunSound", gun.Parent, {
        SourceUserId = sourcePlayer and sourcePlayer.UserId,
        FallbackPosition = cframe.Position,
        SourceKey = sourcePlayer and ("gun:" .. tostring(sourcePlayer.UserId)) or nil,
    })

    if PointLight then
        PointLight.Enabled = true
        task.wait(0.1)
        PointLight.Enabled = false
    end
end

function GameHelper:UpdateCharacterInArea(ZonePart:Part,onZoneTag:string)
	local characters:{Model} = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player)

	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

	local hits = workspace:GetPartsInPart(ZonePart,overlapParams)
	for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
		local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
		local index = table.find(characters,character)
		if index then
			table.remove(characters,index)
			if not character:HasTag(onZoneTag) then
				print(character.Name, "AddTag",onZoneTag)
				character:AddTag(onZoneTag)
			end
		end
	end

	for _,character in ipairs(characters) do
		if character:HasTag(onZoneTag) then
			print(character.Name, "RemoveTag",onZoneTag)
			character:RemoveTag(onZoneTag)
		end
	end
end

function GameHelper:AnimalChangeToBuddy(player:Player,animal:Model,cframe:CFrame)
    local enemyLo = EnemyHelper:GetLoByEnemy(animal)
    if not cframe then
        cframe = animal:GetPivot()
    end
    -- GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(nil,animal,99999)
    animal.Parent = nil
    Debris:AddItem(animal,1)

    local prefab:Model = nil
    local inUseSkinId = DataHelper:GetInUseSkin(player,CommonEnum.SkinType.AnimalBuddy,enemyLo.id)
    if inUseSkinId then
        local skinLo:AnimalBuddySkinSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(AnimalBuddySkinSetting,inUseSkinId)
        prefab = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("皮肤"):FindFirstChild("动物伙伴皮肤"):FindFirstChild(skinLo.prefabName)
    end

    if not prefab then
        prefab = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("伙伴"):FindFirstChild(enemyLo.name)
    end
    if not prefab then
        prefab = EnemyHelper:GetPrefab(enemyLo.id)
    end
    local buddy = prefab:Clone()

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(buddy,AnimalBuddyValue)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue)

    ValueHelper:SetValue(buddy,AnimalBuddyValue.id,enemyLo.id)

    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"基础",enemyLo.speed)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.attackDistance,"基础",enemyLo.attackDistance)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.attackCD,"基础",enemyLo.attackCD)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.atkDamage,"基础",enemyLo.atkDamage)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.displayName,enemyLo.displayName)

    buddy:PivotTo(cframe)
    buddy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Buddy)
    buddy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AnimalBuddy)
    buddy.Parent = workspace

    return buddy
end

function GameHelper:CreateBeast(player:Player,cframe:CFrame?)
	if not player then return end

	local character:Model = player.Character

	-- 召唤
    if not cframe then
        cframe = character:GetPivot()
    end

	local prefab:Model = workspace.Prefabs:FindFirstChild("伙伴"):FindFirstChild("Beast")
	local buddy = prefab:Clone()

	ValueHelper:InitByModel(buddy,AnimalBuddyValue)
	ValueHelper:InitByModel(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue)
	ValueHelper:InitByModel(buddy,BeastAttributeValue)

    local buddyConfig = game.ReplicatedStorage.Jobs:FindFirstChild("驯兽师"):FindFirstChild("猛兽")
	ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"基础",buddyConfig:FindFirstChild("移动速度").Value)
	ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.attackDistance,"基础",buddyConfig:FindFirstChild("攻击距离").Value)
	ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.attackCD,"基础",buddyConfig:FindFirstChild("攻击间隔").Value)
	ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.atkDamage,"基础",buddyConfig:FindFirstChild("伤害").Value)
	ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.bodySize,"基础",buddy:GetScale())

	buddy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Buddy)

	buddy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastBuddy)

    return buddy

function GameHelper:IsMove(character:Model)
    if not character then return false end

    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return false end

    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end

    return humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
end

function GameHelper:KickAss_Client(character:Model,hitPos:Vector3)
	if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then return end
	local humanoid:Humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	if humanoid.Sit then
		humanoid.Sit = false
	end
	humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
	
	local Torso:Part = character:WaitForChild("Torso")
	local offset = (character:GetPivot().Position - hitPos)
	local dir = (offset * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit

	local velocity = dir * 30 + Vector3.new(0,10,0)
	local a = 30
	Torso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity
	Torso.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(a,math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a))
end

-- 击飞
function GameHelper:KickAss(character:Model,hitPos:Vector3)
	if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then return end
	local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if humanoid.Sit then
		humanoid.Sit = false
	end
	humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)

	local Torso = character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local offset = (character:GetPivot().Position - hitPos)
	local dir = (offset * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit

	local velocity = dir * 30 + Vector3.new(0,10,0)
	local a = 30
	Torso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity
	Torso.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(a,math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a))
end

function GameHelper:PlaySnowSmash(pos:Vector3,num:number?,force:number?)
	local color = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	-- local force = 50
    if not force then force = 50 end

	local lifeTime = 3
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(lifeTime * 0.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,lifeTime * 0.5)
    if not num then num = 20 end
	for i = 1,num do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Color = color
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.Massless = true
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Snow
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		part:AddTag("SnowballDebris")

		local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5))
		part.Size = Vector3.one * (1 + math.random() * 2)
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + offset)
		part.Parent = workspace

		local force3 = Vector3.new(math.random(-force,force),force,math.random(-force,force)) 
		part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = force3
		part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = force3.Unit * 20

		local tween = game.TweenService:Create(part,tweenInfo,{
			Transparency = 1,
		})
		tween:Play()
		game.Debris:AddItem(part,lifeTime)
	end
end
